change_summary: Shadow-audited the normal strict day-2 25% follow-through add-on event stream with one extra trigger-quality condition: require positive ticker close-to-close return from entry day to checkpoint day. No shared production strategy code was changed.
hypothesis: For the strict day-2 follow-through add-on candidate, requiring the ticker's day-2 close-to-close return to be positive may remove noisy gap/market-lift cases and improve add-on materiality without changing entries, exits, ranking, LLM, or hard risk controls.
notes: Result: rejected as redundant trigger quality. Across late_strong, mid_weak, and old_thin, normal add-on EV delta sum stayed +0.0447 and PnL delta sum +1523.89; all 14 executed add-ons already passed positive ticker day2 return, retaining 100% of estimated add-on forward PnL. Do not spend a follow-up adding this condition to BacktestEngine.

locked_variables: day2 +2% RS-positive 25% add-on; only ticker day2 return confirmation varies
